sourceBrief: A single 45-minute introductory statistics lesson for adult beginners: calculate a sample proportion and distinguish a sample result from a population claim. Source facts: 20 volunteers joined a daytime workshop; 16 completed it; the sample completion proportion is 16/20 = 0.80 = 80%; night-shift workers could not attend; volunteering can introduce selection bias; these data alone do not establish the completion rate for all adult learners. Include a worked calculation, practice, an answer key, and clear limitations.
